name: baseball-cap
description: A baseball cap seen from the front, with a curved crown and broad projecting visor.
useCase: Identify baseball caps or casual headwear in a clothing catalogue.
misuse: Use a visible label when clothing identifies a product, size or dress requirement.

16.reason: A divided curved crown sits above the broad open visor.

24.reason: The larger cap keeps the crown panels and curved visor clear.
